name: Hinoki
subtitle: PS Vita emulator for iOS
description:
Hinoki (formerly Vita3KiOS) is a PlayStation Vita emulator for iPhone and iPad, built on the Vita3K core.

- A PS Vita style home screen with LiveAreas, or a classic library
- Install games, updates and DLC from .vpk, .zip, .pkg, a dumped folder or a Vitamin dump
- One-tap JIT through StikDebug, works in LiveContainer
- RAM helpers for big games, and Keep the phone cool
- Per-game settings, community patches, cheats and mods
- On-screen controls you can rearrange, controller support and button remapping
- External storage: keep your games on a USB drive, SSD or SD card

You need your own PS Vita firmware and games.

Discord (help and bug reports): https://discord.gg/pZyQDPHKF

versions.localizedDescription:
Hinoki 1.6.0

New: Nintendo 3DS
- Nintendo 3DS games, built on the Azahar core: on the home screen next to PS Vita games; .3ds, .cci, .cia and .3dsx files and zips of them; keys import; Old and New 3DS modes
- Controls made to be held: slide your thumb across A B X Y (between two buttons presses both), Edit controls to move and resize them, a layout picker with side-by-side and controls-below layouts, a floating Circle Pad
- Fast forward, save states, and the iOS keyboard for games' text prompts
- On each game's page: updates and DLC, cheats, mods (zip, folder or code patch), save import and export (Checkpoint / JKSM), artwork from libretro and SteamGridDB, names and details
- Performance: shapes Metal can't draw directly now run on the GPU, shader JIT, frame pacing matched to the screen, performance cores, compiled shaders kept between sessions, repeated frames of 30 FPS games skipped
- Foldables and resizable windows: the two screens meet at the fold

PS Vita
- Faster busy 3D scenes: textures are checked for changes once per scene instead of at every draw
- No more slowdown in games that use thousands of textures (four times the texture slots)
- Graphics: depth sampling fixes, vertex clip planes, wide strided textures, occlusion queries, native PVRTC textures
- PS TV mode: on-screen L2, R2, L3 and R3 work, the setting is no longer overridden by per-game settings, and the touch controls stay player 1 with a controller connected
- Controls: floating sticks, screen-half sticks, touch reach, macro buttons, a to-scale PS Vita button map
- Game threads: precise timers, busy threads kept on the performance cores, gentler when the phone is hot
- Plugins: built-in kubridge for ports, plugin manager
- Game fixes download from a mirror when GitHub can't be reached, and the important ones are built in
- Fixes from upstream Vita3K: creating save data, a loading hang, guest call stack alignment and more

Both
- Imports from a game's page work again (updates, mods, saves, cheats, patches) with Apple's file picker or Hinoki's own, folders included
- Import your own cheat (.psv) and patch (.txt) files for PS Vita games
- Menus in Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Chinese (Simplified) and Japanese, following the iPhone's language
- Cloud saves through iCloud Drive; settings reorganized
- Other apps' videos and the camera work while Hinoki is open


## Install
- **AltStore / SideStore:** add the source `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oledz-i/Hinoki/main/dist/altstore/source.json` to get updates in-app.
- **LiveContainer / TrollStore / other signers:** download `Hinoki-1.6.0.ipa` below.

Build 277, commit 2a0c814.

Hinoki 1.5.1

Fixes
- Missing text in games that draw their text into 16-bit surfaces
- Dialogue that ran too fast in some games (audio envelope, audio timing, HE-AAC voices)
- 2D trail effects broken since 1.2.0
- Black screen at game start while the shader pipeline cache loaded (it now loads in the background)
- Crashes on installs without the extended address space (free SideStore signing): smaller JIT pool and texture cache there; menu music can no longer crash the app
- A crash when a game's GPU sync data was damaged
- Deleting a single file from save data now really deletes it
- Opening Control Center while folding a page on the PS Vita home screen
- More game fixes ported from Vita3K-Plus

Performance
- Shorter pause while JIT is set up (smaller code cache pool, same thread count), with an "Enabling JIT..." note
- Smoother library while JIT is prepared; menu music waits until JIT is ready

New
- V-Sync setting (global and per game)
- TV mode reworked: its own setting, the game shows only on the TV (standalone installs)
- RAM helpers retry by themselves, work in Strata 4.0 / LiveContainer with Helper Process Support, and say exactly what to change when they can't start
- Settings > About > Setup check: JIT, memory, address space, RAM helpers, firmware and storage at a glance, with fixes and a copyable summary
- Continue playing card in the library
- Ad hoc play over the internet through a relay server (thanks MrBouza)
- Dialog screens refresh correctly (thanks MrBouza)

## Install
- **AltStore / SideStore:** add the source `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oledz-i/Hinoki/main/dist/altstore/source.json` to get updates in-app.
- **LiveContainer / TrollStore / other signers:** download `Hinoki-1.5.1.ipa` below.

Build 244, commit f6c76d2.

**Built-in JIT**
- No JIT app needed: import your pairing file once (Settings › Built-in JIT) and Hinoki enables JIT by itself every time it opens. Powered by StikJIT from the StikDebug team.
- LocalDevVPN has to be connected. Not available inside LiveContainer (use StikDebug there).

**TV mode**
- AirPlay screen mirroring or an HDMI adapter puts the game full screen on the TV, and the phone becomes the controller (tap empty space for the touchscreen).

**Local multiplayer (experimental)**
- Ad hoc play between phones on the same Wi-Fi or hotspot: Settings › Multiplayer.

**Performance and heat**
- The renderer no longer keeps a CPU core busy while waiting: cooler, and more room for the game.
- New shaders compile faster and objects pop in less.
- Short waits in games no longer spin the CPU.

**Graphics**
- Images games draw for themselves (skies, crowds, players, stadium screens) show up with surface sync, which no longer overwrites game data.
- Widescreen works in more games.
- Texture memory is capped by your phone's RAM: fewer games closed by iOS.

**Fixes**
- Videos in other apps play normally while Hinoki is in the background.
- No crackly audio in heavy scenes with Keep cool on.
- A button to hide the top row of on-screen buttons.
- Game fix updates.

- **LiveContainer / TrollStore / other signers:** download `Hinoki-1.5.0.ipa` below.

Build 219, commit 034e92c.

**Hinoki v1.4.0.1**

- **Sound:** fixed games with no sound where dialogue and subtitles raced ahead. Game audio is back on Vita3K's own sound engine.
- **Other apps' videos:** Hinoki no longer takes the phone's audio back while it is in the background and never turns other apps down, which kept videos in other apps from playing.
- **Leaving the app:** leaving again right after coming back no longer gets Hinoki closed by iOS.

Build 188, commit be68253.

**Hinoki v1.4.0**

- **New name and look:** Vita3KiOS is now Hinoki, with a new icon and in-app mark.
- **Faster and cooler:** Fast CPU on by default. The phone steps down earlier when warm (background game threads and shader compiles ease off, upscaling falls back to bilinear while hot, no 120 Hz). Unused JIT memory is given back to iOS (about 900 MB).
- **Crash fixes:** fixed a JIT bug that sent games into the wrong code once a thread's code cache filled up (a splash-screen hang and likely other random crashes); reused threads no longer run code from unloaded modules (crash when a second video plays); shader compiles pause while the app is in the background (crash after leaving the app); damaged GPU data in a game's memory no longer takes the app down.
- **Graphics:** fixed vertex data that caused spikes and broken models in 3D scenes.
- **New:** experimental per-game widescreen hack, now working in more games; show or hide the performance overlay mid-game (thanks MrBouza).
- **New:** Vitamin dumps and games that start through a small launcher.
- **RAM helper:** stays alive while a game runs, clearer errors when it can't start, memory breakdown in the log and overlay.
- **Extras:** five new home backgrounds, better crash reports and logs.

## Install
- **AltStore / SideStore:** add the source `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oledz-i/Hinoki/main/dist/altstore/source.json` to get updates in-app.
- **LiveContainer / TrollStore / other signers:** download `Hinoki-1.4.0.ipa` below.

Build 184, commit b3dd8b7.

RAM helpers: start-up fix, a memory self-test and detailed logs. JIT: Vita3K keeps running while the JIT app attaches, and logs each step. Quitting a game no longer waits for queued shader compiles. Fixed shaders Metal refused. Games that start networking twice no longer fail. More detailed logs, with a summary at the end of every session.

Build 159, commit 50ad17a.

## Vita3KiOS 1.3.0

### PS Vita home screen (beta, Settings › Appearance)
- Pages of glossy bubbles you swipe sideways, with page dots and arrows, like a real Vita
- Information bar with large buttons for Search, Settings, Themes, Music and Library; Content Manager stays on the first page
- Start screen and LiveAreas you peel away from the top-right corner
- Each game's own LiveArea (background, gate, frames, manual) from its files; games without one get their artwork and a details strip
- Seven built-in themes (Frutiger Aero style backgrounds), plus themes and home music from your firmware
- Smoother, more satisfying taps and transitions

### Memory
- RAM helpers (beta, Settings › Memory): helper processes lend memory for games, so iOS is less likely to close big games. Works in LiveContainer 3.8.13+ with helper processes turned on
- RAM checker: device RAM, Vita3K's usage and limit, and what the helpers lend

### Compatibility and fixes
- Games that write memory from vertex shaders no longer lose those draws on Metal
- Games that start and end many threads wait briefly for a free JIT region instead of failing
- Added the memory: device some games use at boot
- Quitting no longer stalls on network sockets
- JIT, crash and stability fixes from upstream Vita3K and Vita3K-Plus

## Install
- **AltStore / SideStore:** add the source `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oledz-i/Hinoki/main/dist/altstore/source.json` to get updates in-app.
- **LiveContainer / TrollStore / other signers:** download `Vita3KiOS-1.3.0.ipa` below.

Build 149, commit 2d31aae.

Game audio now comes back after switching to another app and returning. Credit to MrBouza.

- **AltStore / SideStore:** add the source `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oledz-i/Hinoki/main/dist/altstore/source.json` to get updates in-app.

Build 112, commit 865b986.

Fixes bent and stretched character models in 3D games. FSR works again. The on-screen keyboard now appears for game text prompts. Fixes a crash on some in-game videos and audio decoding that kept failing after one bad frame. The app now keeps trying to hand audio back to iOS so videos in other apps can play. Many game compatibility fixes ported from Vita3K-Plus. JIT starts even if StikDebug attaches late, with bigger caches for busy threads. Clearer crash reports. Credits added for MrBouza and Vita3K-Plus.

- **AltStore / SideStore:** add the source `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oledz-i/Hinoki/main/dist/altstore/source.json` to get updates in-app.
- **LiveContainer / TrollStore / other signers:** download `Vita3KiOS-1.2.0.ipa` below.

Build 109, commit fcb1624.

### Fixes
- Vita3K now hands the iPhone's audio back to other apps as soon as it leaves the screen, and takes it again when you return. It used to hold on to it until it was closed, which is the likely cause of videos not playing in other apps until a restart. If that still happens on this version, please report it with your iOS version and whether closing Vita3K from the app switcher fixes it.

## Install
- **AltStore / SideStore:** add the source `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oledz-i/Hinoki/main/dist/altstore/source.json` to get updates in-app.
- **LiveContainer / TrollStore / other signers:** download `Vita3KiOS-1.1.2.ipa` below.

Build 88, commit ae3a386.

### New
- Licenses: add a game's work.bin / .rif or paste its zRIF from the + menu (License section). Licenses inside a zip or folder are picked up automatically.
- Save data import from a modded Vita or another Vita3K, as a zip or a folder, in any of the usual layouts. The current save is backed up to Files › Vita3KiOS › Save Backups first.

### Fixes
- Pausing really stops the GPU: no more heat while paused, and no more game closing after you leave the app while paused.
- The game pauses as soon as Vita3K leaves the screen, and GPU errors while off screen no longer close the game or change its settings.
- No more app crash when the GPU fails while the screen turns, on unsupported coprocessor instructions, or on a damaged game heap.
- Archive installer: zips made on Windows, damaged or incomplete archives, unsupported compression and full storage are handled with a clear message instead of a half-installed game.
- Crash reports name the code behind a bad memory access.

### Performance and battery
- Shader compilation and the renderer step down when the phone is hot or in Low Power Mode.
- Steadier frame pacing when the phone is warm.
- Fewer stutters from log writes during play.
- The screen can dim and lock while a game is paused.

## Install
- **AltStore / SideStore:** add the source `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oledz-i/Hinoki/main/dist/altstore/source.json` to get updates in-app.
- **LiveContainer / TrollStore / other signers:** download `Vita3KiOS-1.1.1.ipa` below.

Build 86, commit 5abaa93.

## Vita3KiOS 1.1.0

**New**
- Pause button, and Pause/Resume in the game menu. The game menu pauses the game while it is open.
- Memory mapping choice: Double buffer, Native buffer or Off (Settings › Graphics and per game).
- Portrait mode: games start in landscape and turn upright once they are on screen.
- Keep the phone cool (Settings › Performance, on by default).
- Darker touch controls.

**Fixes**
- No crash after leaving the app for a while: nothing is drawn while paused or in the background.
- Games no longer freeze when the phone is turned, and Quit no longer hangs or writes false crash reports.
- Fewer GPU failures at boot. A damaged shader cache no longer stops a game from starting.
- Textures and buffers no longer go stale with Native buffer (stray shapes, missing stadium stands in Madden NFL 13).
- Textures cut from game-drawn images are read from the right place.
- No crash when Metal cannot build a shader (One Piece Burning Blood).
- Dead or Alive 5 Plus and other thread-heavy games: room for 64 game threads.
- Madden NFL 13: surface sync works with Native buffer (recommended settings). No crash with surface sync and high accuracy.

**Smoother**
- Shader cache saves run in the background instead of hitching a frame.
- Bigger texture cache, so fewer reloads.
- Faster shader cache loading.
- Lower GPU overhead per frame.

Known issue: Madden NFL 13 player faces still render deformed.

The first release of Vita3KiOS: the full [Vita3K](https://github.com/Vita3K/Vita3K) PlayStation Vita emulator as a native iPhone and iPad app.

## Highlights
- **Full Vita3K core**: CPU recompiler, GXM → Vulkan renderer (MoltenVK), HLE, kept in sync with upstream
- **JIT on iOS 26** through StikDebug's `universal.js` (from [Tsubomi](https://github.com/125hz/Tsubomi)), set up in one batched step
- **Install anything**: `.pkg`, `.vpk`, `.zip` and dumped folders, including **updates and DLC**. Zips of `.pkg`s install in order (game → update → DLC); updates never ask for a zRIF
- **Per-game sheet**: settings, community patches (60 FPS, resolution, fixes), cheats (VitaCheat database built in), rePatch mods, updates & DLC, save backups
- **Performance**: 60 FPS mode, Fast CPU, upscaling up to 4× with FSR, background shader compilation, a shader cache kept between sessions, game threads on the performance cores
- **Performance overlay** you configure: FPS, frame time, CPU, memory, thermals, battery, resolution
- **Game menu**: screenshots to Photos, rear touchpad, show/hide controls, quit (✕ on screen, Home/PS on a controller, or hold Select + Start)
- **Touch controls**: drag and pinch them into your own layout; themes (PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo-style letters, Neon, Minimal)
- **Controllers**: MFi, Xbox, PlayStation and Switch, with remapping and a ✕/○ swap
- **Motion controls** that follow the landscape screen
- **iOS integration**: Home Screen launch links (`vita3k://launch/<TITLE ID>`), recent games on the app icon, "Open in Vita3K" from Files and Safari, external drives for storage
- **Crash reports** with the log one tap away; animated themes and original menu music

## Requirements
iOS 17.4 or later on an A12 chip or newer, StikDebug for JIT, and your own firmware and game dumps. Game compatibility follows upstream Vita3K: see the [compatibility list](https://vita3k.org/compatibility.html).

## Install
- **AltStore / SideStore:** add the source `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oledz-i/Hinoki/main/dist/altstore/source.json` to get updates in-app.
- **LiveContainer / TrollStore / other signers:** download `Vita3KiOS-1.0.0.ipa` below.

Build 46, commit ed16fba.
